ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Narrative, Sequence, Installation. This course will explore the narrative and poetics of sequencing and installing image-based work. The meaning of images will be considered through the context they situate in. Readings, lectures, screenings, and assignments will develop the use and understanding of serial imagery by engaging in a variety of sequences, books, zines, portfolios, web-based projects, and installations. Students should have previous experience with image-based courses/projects and have personal projects to work on. Physical prints are required to be produced throughout the semester.
